nodes.label: Public Brand Logo — Ornate Illustrated Badge Transparent (PNG)
nodes.description: PNG with transparent background. Visually identical to Logo_v2.png: the ornate, richly illustrated Chicken Time badge with gold scrollwork border, crimson red background, cream 'CHICKEN TIME' arced text, bronze clock face with crossed cutlery, chili and flame motifs, colourful cockerel mascot holding hot sauce with chef's hat, and brown ribbon banner reading 'Piri Piri & Perfection' / 'EST. 2024'. This is the production-deployed brand logo served from the public assets directory of the Next.js app.
